## About

Sydney Thomas is a ring girl, cheerleader and influencer who garnered viral attention after her November 2024 appearance on Netflix's Jake Paul vs. Mike Tyson boxing fight. Thomas began regularly posting on TikTok and Instagram in 2021 and garnered a steady following with her lip dub, vlog and dance content. She is employed as a cheerleader for the MLB under the St. Louis Cardinals. In November 2024, her appearance at the Paul vs. Tyson fight garnered her further acclaim online, inspiring memes and discourse about Thomas.

## Online History

Sydney Thomas began regularly posting content to her Instagram[1] page, iamsydneythomas, on January 11th, 2021. On July 3rd, she posted her first video to TikTok.[2]

Thomas had numerous videos go viral with multiple millions of views between 2021 and 2024. For example, on April 30th, 2022, a TikTok[3] video of her dancing at prom captioned "prom too turnt" garnered over 2.6 million views in two years.

## About

Sydney Thomas is a ring girl, cheerleader and influencer who garnered viral attention after her November 2024 appearance on Netflix's Jake Paul vs. Mike Tyson boxing fight. Thomas began regularly posting on TikTok and Instagram in 2021 and garnered a steady following with her lip dub, vlog and dance content. She is employed as a cheerleader for the MLB under the St. Louis Cardinals. In November 2024, her appearance at the Paul vs. Tyson fight garnered her further acclaim online, inspiring memes and discourse about Thomas.

## Online History

Sydney Thomas began regularly posting content to her Instagram[1] page, iamsydneythomas, on January 11th, 2021. On July 3rd, she posted her first video to TikTok.[2]

Thomas had numerous videos go viral with multiple millions of views between 2021 and 2024. For example, on April 30th, 2022, a TikTok[3] video of her dancing at prom captioned "prom too turnt" garnered over 2.6 million views in two years.

it's so lit dude

♬ You suck off james Charles if u uses this – M.

On June 10th, 2023, Thomas posted a video to TikTok[4] in which she talks about her job as a cheerleader for the St. Louis Cardinals, garnering over 974,000 views in a year.

@iamsydneythomas it was a busy one today at the ballpark. hope yall enjoy getting to see a little of what it looks like working at the stadium. go cards!!#cardinals#teamfredbird#tfb#stlouiscardinals#stl#saintlouis#mlb♬ original sound – Sydney Thomas

On October 18th, Thomas posted a video to TikTok[5] of herself drinking from a bowl and apparently attempting to cure a hangover, garnering over 4.5 million views in a year.

@iamsydneythomas waking up hungover and having to go out again. this is the cure. promise. works every time.#college#rolltide#bama♬ original sound – livies hq ❤️

#### Ring Girl at Paul vs. Tyson Fight

On November 15th, 2024, Sydney Thomas worked as a ring girl at the Jake Paul vs. Mike Tyson fight, where she appeared numerous times on-stream. On November 15th and 16th, she posted collections of photographs of herself at the arena to Instagram,[6][7] each collection garnering over 100,000 likes in five days.

Also on November 15th, she posted a video to TikTok[8] of herself at the arena, garnering over 15 million views in five days and becoming her most-viewed video of all time.

@iamsydneythomas ring girl, close enough 🤷🏼‍♀️#paulvstyson#ringgirl♬ Ring trend – Audreyy

## Online Presence

As of November 20th, 2024, Sydney Thomas has over 677,000 followers on Instagram and 961,000 followers on TikTok.

Following her appearance at the Tyson vs. Paul fight, Thomas inspired memes, reactions and discourse online, mostly from people sharing how attractive they find her.

On November 15th, 2024, X[9] user @JoelLoren1 posted photos of Thomas appearing behind Amanda Serrano, writing, "Cognitive dissonance, ring girl bimbos juxtaposed with women who have broken their faces in a farce of blood sport," garnering over 3,600 likes in five days.

On November 16th, X[10] user @luhaxel posted a photo of Thomas, writing, "the best thing that happened at the fight last night was netflix’s ring girl 😮‍💨," garnering over 41,000 likes in four days. On November 19th, she was interviewed by Fox News [11] about her appearance at the fight.

## Personal Life

Sydney Thomas was born on November 26th, 2003, and attended the University of Alabama. She is a cheerleader for the St. Louis Cardinals.

## ‘Abundance Frequency’ Trend Revives Anita Ward’s 1979 Hot 100 No. 1 Classic

Times are tough, and global war is only turning up the pressure. So, naturally, people are turning to TikTok for money guidance, and some of found solace in user@/goddessinanna15 and her “abundance frequency” videos. In essence, “Ring My Bell,” the 1979 Billboard Hot 100 chart-topper from Anita Ward, apparently continues sonic frequencies that inspire financial abundance. In a Jan. 12 post, TikTok user @/goddessinanna15 claimed “Ring My Bell” is a “matrix hack” that will “bring money and wealth” because it correlates with the following phrases in numerology: “I am wealthy,” “win money,” “manifest” and “Johnny Cash.”

To close out her clip, which has since amassed over a quarter-million views, the user also claimed that she won a $5 scratch-off prize while listening to Ward’s signature hit. Later that week (Jan. 16& 17), she shared two more viral posts expanding on the “abundance frequency”-“Ring My Bell” theory. Additionally, TikTok user@/sinai_rose launched a “Ring My Bell” dance challenge on March 3, with a clip that’s already earned over 280,000 views.

Now, whether any of this is true is besides the point. What truly matters is that people have bought into the “abundance frequency,” which has helped revived “Ring My Bell” on streaming. According to Luminate, “Ring” earned over 671,000 official on-demand U.S. streams during the period of Feb. 20-26, selling an additional 300 U.S. digital downloads. By the following week (Feb. 27-March 5), “Ring” jumped 277% to 2.53 million official streams, with its U.S. digital downloads total vaulting 1,001% to over 3,4000 copies. On TikTok, the official “Ring My Bell” sound boasts over 5,000 videos, many of which are now tied to manifestations of wealth and prosperity.

Even if “Ring My Bell” does absolutely nothing for people’s finances, at least it’s finding a way into the hearts and playlists of a new generation of listeners. — KYLE DENIS

---

## A ‘Go Away’ Comeback for Weezer and Bethany Cosentino

Another week, another ’90s alternative act striking TikTok gold with a many-albums-ago deep cut. This time, it’s Weezer‘s turn in the streaming spotlight, with the California vets’ “Go Away” — a highlight from 2014’s Everything Will Be Alright in the End album, featuring West Coast alt-rock fixture Bethan Cosentino of Best Coast — blowing up on TikTok over the past couple months, with users finding a variety of uses for the song’s male/female vocal interplay and lovelorn lyrics.

The TikTok interest in the song has translated to massive streaming gains over the past two months. Whereas at the beginning of 2026, for the tracking week ending Jan. 1, “Go Away” was only amassing 56,000 weekly official on-demand U.S. streams (according to Luminate), the song has skyrocketed to nearly 2.8 million streams for the week ending March 5, with its numbers still rising in the days since. The song has even entered Spotify’s Daily Top Songs USA chart, reaching a new peak of No. 153 on Tuesday (Mar. 10).

Both Weezer and Cosentino have since joined in the TikTok fun, with the latter getting 6.6 million views so far for a video of her performing the song on a toy guitar with the caption “when a song you cowrote and sang on 12 years ago goes viral and now you are someone’s mom,” and the former even posting a new lyric video with the monster on the Alright album cover lip synching to the song. (“Everything is still alright in the end,” the caption concludes.)

---

## Dance Trend Lifts SAILORR & Eem Triplin’s ‘Coconut’

Choreographer, dancer, and TikTok user@/jeanvictorm has finally escaped the shadow of his viral “Needed Me” dance with a new, particulalry satisfying combination set to SAILORR’s “Coconut,” an Eem Triplin-assisted joint housed on her From Florida’s Finest Delu/XXX album.

Victor shared the first look at his choreography via his official TikTok page in a Feb. 5 clip that’s since earned over 631,000 views and nearly 100,000 likes. He quickly caught onto the dance trend’s budding virality with a follow-up clip on Feb. 11 (this time featuring himself and fellow TikTok dance star Orlando Lucas), which soon gave way to a litany of tutroial clips that helped non-professionals nail every move. While the unofficial “Coconut” sound boasts just under 6,500 clips, the official sound plays in over 17,000.

During the period of Jan. 23-29, “Cocount” racked up 366,000 official on-demand U.S. streams. Roughly a month later (Feb. 27-March 5), that figure soared 216% to over 1.15 million official weekly streams. With her buzz continuing to build thanks to her writing contributions on Baby Keem’s “Good Flirts,” SAILORR may just have unlocked a rising hit of her own. — KD

The internet will take literally anything and turn it into a self-help ritual. Right now, that includes a disco song from 1979 and a bunch of people hoping it pays their bills.

The chosen artifact is Anita Ward’s disco hit “Ring My Bell,” which has become the latest TikTok-approved “money magnet.” Users have been using the song as a manifestation tool, claiming that if you play it on repeat, dance to it, and pair it with the right affirmations, cash, luck, jobs, and other nice little surprises will start appearing in your life. The trend was pushed by TikTok creator@GoddessInanna15, who described it as a “Matrix hack” and a “manifestation and reset frequency.”

## Videos by VICE

Now, on one hand, I get it. The economy is a joke, rent is demonic, and a lot of people are trying to feel some level of control over their lives without looking at their bank account and wanting to pass out. If dancing around your apartment to disco helps you feel like abundance is possible, that is, at minimum, cheaper than some wellness habits currently being sold online.

This video breaks down the real secret sauce behind Ring My Bell by Anita Ward and why it works so powerfully as a manifestation and reset frequency. It’s not just the hertz, and it’s not as simple as plugging a phrase into a gematria calculator. Words carry frequency, numbers carry geometry, and Anita Ward’s own numerology locks this song into a very specific energetic signature. I walk you through the patterns in the notes you see on screen, how the cipher connects phrases like “I am wealthy,” “Win money,” and “Cancel my debt,” and why this track functions as a feminine receiving portal. When you understand how words, numbers, and sound weave reality, the whole pattern becomes obvious.#fypシ゚#fypシ゚viral#matrixhack#ringmybell#matrixglitch

## Gen Z Put This Song on Repeat to Manifest Good Luck and Cash

The trend has clearly found an audience. The New York Post reported that over 5,000 clips using the music were posted in recent weeks, while Billboard said streams of “Ring My Bell” jumped 277% over the past month, reaching 2.53 million official streams in a single week. Some users swear the song brought them gigs, cash, and ideal thrift finds. That sounds more like a run of good timing than anything mystical.

There are elements of this that are real, even if the magic-money angle is not. The Post quoted Dr. Patrick K. Porter, founder of BrainTap Technologies, saying, “Music activates multiple brain systems simultaneously—emotional centers, memory networks, attention pathways.” He also said repeated listening can strengthen neural pathways, especially when emotion and intention are involved. Audio expert Nikki Camilleri told the paper that a song can become “a shortcut to a target mental state.”

That explanation isn’t as fun as “disco song unlocks wealth portal,” but it’s also a lot easier to believe. A song can hype you up, pull you out of a bad headspace, and make you feel a little more on top of your game, a little luckier, a little readier to get out of your comfort zone. That explanation is believable. The rest feels like people on TikTok giving a catchy song way too much power.

# Description

Note : `This project uses the API from Tiktok & Unofficial Tiktok API from Another Website. This project is not affiliated with Tiktok. `

- This project is made to help users to download videos, images / slides and music from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to view someone's profile from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to view comments from a video on Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to search for users, live streams and videos on Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to get user's posts, reposts and liked videos from Tiktok.
- This project is made to help users to get videos, images / slides from a Tiktok collection or playlist.
- This project is also made to help users to get trending content and creators from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to get videos that use a specific music/audio track by music ID from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to get detailed information about a music/audio track from Tiktok.

# Quick Installation

Install using our automated script:

```bash
curl -o install.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TobyG74/tiktok-api-dl/master/install.sh
chmod +x install.sh
./install.sh
```

The script automatically:

- Verifies Node.js installation and version
- Installs the library using npm or yarn
- Provides usage examples

# Usage Guide

## Getting Tiktok Cookie

1. Install [Cookie-Editor](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cookie-editor/hlkenndednhfkekhgcdicdfddnkalmdm)
2. Login to [Tiktok](https://tiktok.com)
3. Open Cookie-Editor
4. Copy the cookie and use it in your code: `COOKIE: "YOUR_COOKIE"`

## Using CLI

### Global Installation

```bash
npm install -g @tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl
tiktokdl [command] [options]
```

### Direct Usage

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TobyG74/tiktok-api-dl.git
cd tiktok-api-dl
npm install
npx ts-node src/cli/index.ts [command] [options]
```

### NPM Script

```bash
npm run cli  [command] [options]
```

### CLI Usage

```bash
$ tiktokdl -h
Usage: tiktokdl [options] [command]

Tiktok downloader and search CLI tool

Options:
  -V, --version                output the version number
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  download [options] <url>     Download Tiktok Video / Slide / Music
  cookie                       Cookie Manager
  search                       Search Tiktok users or live streams
  getvideocomments [options] <url>  Get comments from a Tiktok video
  getuserposts [options] <username>  Get posts from a Tiktok user
  getuserreposts [options] <username>  Get reposts from a Tiktok user
  stalk [options] <username>   Stalk a Tiktok user
  help [command]               display help for command
```

### Example Cookie Usage

```bash
# Set Tiktok Cookie to use in commands
tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_COOKIE"

# Get Tiktok Cookie
tiktokdl cookie get

# Delete Tiktok Cookie
tiktokdl cookie delete
```

# Features

## Tiktok Downloader

```javascript
const Tiktok = require("@tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl")

const url = "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx"
Tiktok.Downloader(url, {
  version: "v1", // "v1" | "v2" | "v3"
  proxy: "YOUR_PROXY", // optional
  showOriginalResponse: true // optional, v1 only
}).then((result) => console.log(result))
```

### CLI Usage

```bash
# Download Tiktok Video
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx"

# Download Tiktok Video with version
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx" -v v1

# Download Tiktok Video with Custom Output Directory Path
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx" -v v1 -o "/path/to/save/video.mp4"

# Download Tiktok Video with Proxy
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx" -v v1 -proxy "http://your-proxy-url"

# Download Collection or Playlist
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/collection/name-id"
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/playlist/name-id"

# Download Collection or Playlist with Count
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/collection/name-id" -c 5
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/playlist/name-id" -c 5

# Download Collection or Playlist with Proxy
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/collection/name-id" -c 5 -proxy "http://your-proxy-url"
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/playlist/name-id" -c 5 -proxy "http://your-proxy-url"
```

## Tiktok Search

```javascript
const Tiktok = require("@tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl")

Tiktok.Search("username", {
  type: "user", // "user" | "live" | "video"
  page: 1,
  cookie: "YOUR_COOKIE", // needed
  proxy: "YOUR_PROXY" // optional
}).then((result) => console.log(result))
```

## Tiktok Get Music Detail

Get detailed information about a music/audio track by providing the music ID or URL. This feature uses xttparams encryption for enhanced security.

```javascript
const Tiktok = require("@tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl")

// Using music ID
const musicId = "7562597337407785760"
Tiktok.GetMusicDetail(musicId, {
  cookie: "YOUR_COOKIE", // required
  proxy: "YOUR_PROXY" // optional
}).then((result) => console.log(result))

// Or using music URL
const musicUrl = "https://www.tiktok.com/music/QKThr-6771810675950880769"
Tiktok.GetMusicDetail(musicUrl, {
  cookie: "YOUR_COOKIE"
}).then((result) => console.log(result))
```

### CLI Usage

**Note:** This command requires a cookie. Set your cookie first using `tiktokdl cookie set `

```bash
# Set cookie first (required)
tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_COOKIE_VALUE"

# Get music detail by ID
tiktokdl getmusicdetail 7562597337407785760

# Get music detail by URL
tiktokdl getmusicdetail "https://www.tiktok.com/music/QKThr-6771810675950880769"

# Get music detail with proxy
tiktokdl getmusicdetail 7562597337407785760 --proxy "http://your-proxy-url"

# Get raw JSON response
tiktokdl getmusicdetail 7562597337407785760 -r
```

Download music/audio files from TikTok. Requires cookie authentication.

### CLI Usage for Downloading Music

```bash
# Set cookie first (required for downloading)
tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_TIKTOK_COOKIE"

# Download by music ID
tiktokdl downloadmusic 7562597337407785760

# Download by music URL
tiktokdl downloadmusic "https://www.tiktok.com/music/QKThr-6771810675950880769"

# Custom output directory
tiktokdl downloadmusic 7562597337407785760 -o "./my-music"

# With proxy
tiktokdl downloadmusic 7562597337407785760 --proxy "http://your-proxy-url"
```

**How to get TikTok cookie:**

1. Open TikTok in your browser and login
2. Open DevTools (F12)
3. Go to Application/Storage > Cookies
4. Copy the entire cookie value
5. Set it using: `tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_COOKIE"`

## ‘Abundance Frequency’ Trend Revives Anita Ward’s 1979 Hot 100 No. 1 Classic

Times are tough, and global war is only turning up the pressure. So, naturally, people are turning to TikTok for money guidance, and some of found solace in user@/goddessinanna15 and her “abundance frequency” videos. In essence, “Ring My Bell,” the 1979 Billboard Hot 100 chart-topper from Anita Ward, apparently continues sonic frequencies that inspire financial abundance. In a Jan. 12 post, TikTok user @/goddessinanna15 claimed “Ring My Bell” is a “matrix hack” that will “bring money and wealth” because it correlates with the following phrases in numerology: “I am wealthy,” “win money,” “manifest” and “Johnny Cash.”

To close out her clip, which has since amassed over a quarter-million views, the user also claimed that she won a $5 scratch-off prize while listening to Ward’s signature hit. Later that week (Jan. 16& 17), she shared two more viral posts expanding on the “abundance frequency”-“Ring My Bell” theory. Additionally, TikTok user@/sinai_rose launched a “Ring My Bell” dance challenge on March 3, with a clip that’s already earned over 280,000 views.

Now, whether any of this is true is besides the point. What truly matters is that people have bought into the “abundance frequency,” which has helped revived “Ring My Bell” on streaming. According to Luminate, “Ring” earned over 671,000 official on-demand U.S. streams during the period of Feb. 20-26, selling an additional 300 U.S. digital downloads. By the following week (Feb. 27-March 5), “Ring” jumped 277% to 2.53 million official streams, with its U.S. digital downloads total vaulting 1,001% to over 3,4000 copies. On TikTok, the official “Ring My Bell” sound boasts over 5,000 videos, many of which are now tied to manifestations of wealth and prosperity.

Even if “Ring My Bell” does absolutely nothing for people’s finances, at least it’s finding a way into the hearts and playlists of a new generation of listeners. — KYLE DENIS

---

## A ‘Go Away’ Comeback for Weezer and Bethany Cosentino

Another week, another ’90s alternative act striking TikTok gold with a many-albums-ago deep cut. This time, it’s Weezer‘s turn in the streaming spotlight, with the California vets’ “Go Away” — a highlight from 2014’s Everything Will Be Alright in the End album, featuring West Coast alt-rock fixture Bethan Cosentino of Best Coast — blowing up on TikTok over the past couple months, with users finding a variety of uses for the song’s male/female vocal interplay and lovelorn lyrics.

The TikTok interest in the song has translated to massive streaming gains over the past two months. Whereas at the beginning of 2026, for the tracking week ending Jan. 1, “Go Away” was only amassing 56,000 weekly official on-demand U.S. streams (according to Luminate), the song has skyrocketed to nearly 2.8 million streams for the week ending March 5, with its numbers still rising in the days since. The song has even entered Spotify’s Daily Top Songs USA chart, reaching a new peak of No. 153 on Tuesday (Mar. 10).

Both Weezer and Cosentino have since joined in the TikTok fun, with the latter getting 6.6 million views so far for a video of her performing the song on a toy guitar with the caption “when a song you cowrote and sang on 12 years ago goes viral and now you are someone’s mom,” and the former even posting a new lyric video with the monster on the Alright album cover lip synching to the song. (“Everything is still alright in the end,” the caption concludes.)

---

## Dance Trend Lifts SAILORR & Eem Triplin’s ‘Coconut’

Choreographer, dancer, and TikTok user@/jeanvictorm has finally escaped the shadow of his viral “Needed Me” dance with a new, particulalry satisfying combination set to SAILORR’s “Coconut,” an Eem Triplin-assisted joint housed on her From Florida’s Finest Delu/XXX album.

Victor shared the first look at his choreography via his official TikTok page in a Feb. 5 clip that’s since earned over 631,000 views and nearly 100,000 likes. He quickly caught onto the dance trend’s budding virality with a follow-up clip on Feb. 11 (this time featuring himself and fellow TikTok dance star Orlando Lucas), which soon gave way to a litany of tutroial clips that helped non-professionals nail every move. While the unofficial “Coconut” sound boasts just under 6,500 clips, the official sound plays in over 17,000.

During the period of Jan. 23-29, “Cocount” racked up 366,000 official on-demand U.S. streams. Roughly a month later (Feb. 27-March 5), that figure soared 216% to over 1.15 million official weekly streams. With her buzz continuing to build thanks to her writing contributions on Baby Keem’s “Good Flirts,” SAILORR may just have unlocked a rising hit of her own. — KD

The chosen artifact is Anita Ward’s disco hit “Ring My Bell,” which has become the latest TikTok-approved “money magnet.” Users have been using the song as a manifestation tool, claiming that if you play it on repeat, dance to it, and pair it with the right affirmations, cash, luck, jobs, and other nice little surprises will start appearing in your life. Now, on one hand, I get it. The economy is a joke, rent is demonic, and a lot of people are trying to feel some level of control over their lives without looking at their bank account and wanting to pass out. If dancing around your apartment to disco helps you feel like abundance is possible, that is, at minimum, cheaper than some wellness habits currently being sold online.

This video breaks down the real secret sauce behind Ring My Bell by Anita Ward and why it works so powerfully as a manifestation and reset frequency. It’s not just the hertz, and it’s not as simple as plugging a phrase into a gematria calculator. The trend has clearly found an audience. Some users swear the song brought them gigs, cash, and ideal thrift finds. That sounds more like a run of good timing than anything mystical.

There are elements of this that are real, even if the magic-money angle is not. The Post quoted Dr. Patrick K. # Description

Note : `This project uses the API from Tiktok & Unofficial Tiktok API from Another Website. This project is not affiliated with Tiktok. `

- This project is made to help users to download videos, images / slides and music from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to view someone's profile from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to view comments from a video on Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to search for users, live streams and videos on Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to get user's posts, reposts and liked videos from Tiktok.
- This project is made to help users to get videos, images / slides from a Tiktok collection or playlist.
- This project is also made to help users to get trending content and creators from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to get videos that use a specific music/audio track by music ID from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to get detailed information about a music/audio track from Tiktok.

# Usage Guide

## Getting Tiktok Cookie

1. Install [Cookie-Editor](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cookie-editor/hlkenndednhfkekhgcdicdfddnkalmdm)
2. Login to [Tiktok](https://tiktok.com)
3. Open Cookie-Editor
4. Copy the cookie and use it in your code: `COOKIE: "YOUR_COOKIE"`

## Using CLI

### Global Installation

```bash
npm install -g @tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl
tiktokdl [command] [options]
```

### Direct Usage

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TobyG74/tiktok-api-dl.git
cd tiktok-api-dl
npm install
npx ts-node src/cli/index.ts [command] [options]
```

```bash
$ tiktokdl -h
Usage: tiktokdl [options] [command]

Tiktok downloader and search CLI tool

Options:

Commands:
  download [options] <url>     Download Tiktok Video / Slide / Music
  cookie                       Cookie Manager

  getvideocomments [options] <url>  Get comments from a Tiktok video

# Features

## Tiktok Downloader

```javascript
const Tiktok = require("@tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl")

const url = "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx"
Tiktok.Downloader(url, {
  version: "v1", // "v1" | "v2" | "v3"
  proxy: "YOUR_PROXY", // optional
  showOriginalResponse: true // optional, v1 only
}).then((result) => console.log(result))
```

### CLI Usage

```bash
# Download Tiktok Video
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx"

# Download Tiktok Video with version
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx" -v v1

# Download Tiktok Video with Custom Output Directory Path
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx" -v v1 -o "/path/to/save/video.mp4"

# Download Tiktok Video with Proxy
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx" -v v1 -proxy "http://your-proxy-url"

# Download Collection or Playlist
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/collection/name-id"
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/playlist/name-id"

# Download Collection or Playlist with Count
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/collection/name-id" -c 5
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/playlist/name-id" -c 5

# Download Collection or Playlist with Proxy
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/collection/name-id" -c 5 -proxy "http://your-proxy-url"
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/playlist/name-id" -c 5 -proxy "http://your-proxy-url"
```

## Tiktok Get Music Detail

Get detailed information about a music/audio track by providing the music ID or URL. This feature uses xttparams encryption for enhanced security.

```javascript
const Tiktok = require("@tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl")

// Using music ID
const musicId = "7562597337407785760"
Tiktok.GetMusicDetail(musicId, {
  cookie: "YOUR_COOKIE", // required
  proxy: "YOUR_PROXY" // optional
}).then((result) => console.log(result))

// Or using music URL
const musicUrl = "https://www.tiktok.com/music/QKThr-6771810675950880769"
Tiktok.GetMusicDetail(musicUrl, {
  cookie: "YOUR_COOKIE"
}).then((result) => console.log(result))
```

### CLI Usage

**Note:** This command requires a cookie. Set your cookie first using `tiktokdl cookie set `

```bash
# Set cookie first (required)
tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_COOKIE_VALUE"

# Get music detail by ID
tiktokdl getmusicdetail 7562597337407785760

# Get music detail by URL
tiktokdl getmusicdetail "https://www.tiktok.com/music/QKThr-6771810675950880769"

# Get music detail with proxy
tiktokdl getmusicdetail 7562597337407785760 --proxy "http://your-proxy-url"

# Get raw JSON response
tiktokdl getmusicdetail 7562597337407785760 -r
```

Download music/audio files from TikTok. Requires cookie authentication.

### CLI Usage for Downloading Music

```bash
# Set cookie first (required for downloading)
tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_TIKTOK_COOKIE"

# Download by music ID
tiktokdl downloadmusic 7562597337407785760

# Download by music URL
tiktokdl downloadmusic "https://www.tiktok.com/music/QKThr-6771810675950880769"

# Custom output directory
tiktokdl downloadmusic 7562597337407785760 -o "./my-music"

# With proxy
tiktokdl downloadmusic 7562597337407785760 --proxy "http://your-proxy-url"
```

**How to get TikTok cookie:**

1. Open TikTok in your browser and login
2. Open DevTools (F12)
3. Go to Application/Storage > Cookies
4. Copy the entire cookie value
5. Set it using: `tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_COOKIE"`

## ‘Abundance Frequency’ Trend Revives Anita Ward’s 1979 Hot 100 No. 1 Classic

Times are tough, and global war is only turning up the pressure. So, naturally, people are turning to TikTok for money guidance, and some of found solace in user@/goddessinanna15 and her “abundance frequency” videos. In essence, “Ring My Bell,” the 1979 Billboard Hot 100 chart-topper from Anita Ward, apparently continues sonic frequencies that inspire financial abundance. In a Jan. 12 post, TikTok user @/goddessinanna15 claimed “Ring My Bell” is a “matrix hack” that will “bring money and wealth” because it correlates with the following phrases in numerology: “I am wealthy,” “win money,” “manifest” and “Johnny Cash.”

To close out her clip, which has since amassed over a quarter-million views, the user also claimed that she won a $5 scratch-off prize while listening to Ward’s signature hit. Later that week (Jan. 16& 17), she shared two more viral posts expanding on the “abundance frequency”-“Ring My Bell” theory. Additionally, TikTok user@/sinai_rose launched a “Ring My Bell” dance challenge on March 3, with a clip that’s already earned over 280,000 views.

Now, whether any of this is true is besides the point. What truly matters is that people have bought into the “abundance frequency,” which has helped revived “Ring My Bell” on streaming. According to Luminate, “Ring” earned over 671,000 official on-demand U.S. streams during the period of Feb. 20-26, selling an additional 300 U.S. digital downloads. By the following week (Feb. 27-March 5), “Ring” jumped 277% to 2.53 million official streams, with its U.S. digital downloads total vaulting 1,001% to over 3,4000 copies. On TikTok, the official “Ring My Bell” sound boasts over 5,000 videos, many of which are now tied to manifestations of wealth and prosperity.

Even if “Ring My Bell” does absolutely nothing for people’s finances, at least it’s finding a way into the hearts and playlists of a new generation of listeners. — KYLE DENIS

---

## A ‘Go Away’ Comeback for Weezer and Bethany Cosentino

Another week, another ’90s alternative act striking TikTok gold with a many-albums-ago deep cut. This time, it’s Weezer‘s turn in the streaming spotlight, with the California vets’ “Go Away” — a highlight from 2014’s Everything Will Be Alright in the End album, featuring West Coast alt-rock fixture Bethan Cosentino of Best Coast — blowing up on TikTok over the past couple months, with users finding a variety of uses for the song’s male/female vocal interplay and lovelorn lyrics.

The TikTok interest in the song has translated to massive streaming gains over the past two months. Whereas at the beginning of 2026, for the tracking week ending Jan. 1, “Go Away” was only amassing 56,000 weekly official on-demand U.S. streams (according to Luminate), the song has skyrocketed to nearly 2.8 million streams for the week ending March 5, with its numbers still rising in the days since. The song has even entered Spotify’s Daily Top Songs USA chart, reaching a new peak of No. 153 on Tuesday (Mar. 10).

Both Weezer and Cosentino have since joined in the TikTok fun, with the latter getting 6.6 million views so far for a video of her performing the song on a toy guitar with the caption “when a song you cowrote and sang on 12 years ago goes viral and now you are someone’s mom,” and the former even posting a new lyric video with the monster on the Alright album cover lip synching to the song. (“Everything is still alright in the end,” the caption concludes.)

---

## Dance Trend Lifts SAILORR & Eem Triplin’s ‘Coconut’

Choreographer, dancer, and TikTok user@/jeanvictorm has finally escaped the shadow of his viral “Needed Me” dance with a new, particulalry satisfying combination set to SAILORR’s “Coconut,” an Eem Triplin-assisted joint housed on her From Florida’s Finest Delu/XXX album.

Victor shared the first look at his choreography via his official TikTok page in a Feb. 5 clip that’s since earned over 631,000 views and nearly 100,000 likes. He quickly caught onto the dance trend’s budding virality with a follow-up clip on Feb. 11 (this time featuring himself and fellow TikTok dance star Orlando Lucas), which soon gave way to a litany of tutroial clips that helped non-professionals nail every move. While the unofficial “Coconut” sound boasts just under 6,500 clips, the official sound plays in over 17,000.

During the period of Jan. 23-29, “Cocount” racked up 366,000 official on-demand U.S. streams. Roughly a month later (Feb. 27-March 5), that figure soared 216% to over 1.15 million official weekly streams. With her buzz continuing to build thanks to her writing contributions on Baby Keem’s “Good Flirts,” SAILORR may just have unlocked a rising hit of her own. — KD

The internet will take literally anything and turn it into a self-help ritual. Right now, that includes a disco song from 1979 and a bunch of people hoping it pays their bills.

The chosen artifact is Anita Ward’s disco hit “Ring My Bell,” which has become the latest TikTok-approved “money magnet.” Users have been using the song as a manifestation tool, claiming that if you play it on repeat, dance to it, and pair it with the right affirmations, cash, luck, jobs, and other nice little surprises will start appearing in your life. The trend was pushed by TikTok creator@GoddessInanna15, who described it as a “Matrix hack” and a “manifestation and reset frequency.”

## Videos by VICE

Now, on one hand, I get it. The economy is a joke, rent is demonic, and a lot of people are trying to feel some level of control over their lives without looking at their bank account and wanting to pass out. If dancing around your apartment to disco helps you feel like abundance is possible, that is, at minimum, cheaper than some wellness habits currently being sold online.

This video breaks down the real secret sauce behind Ring My Bell by Anita Ward and why it works so powerfully as a manifestation and reset frequency. It’s not just the hertz, and it’s not as simple as plugging a phrase into a gematria calculator. Words carry frequency, numbers carry geometry, and Anita Ward’s own numerology locks this song into a very specific energetic signature. I walk you through the patterns in the notes you see on screen, how the cipher connects phrases like “I am wealthy,” “Win money,” and “Cancel my debt,” and why this track functions as a feminine receiving portal. When you understand how words, numbers, and sound weave reality, the whole pattern becomes obvious.#fypシ゚#fypシ゚viral#matrixhack#ringmybell#matrixglitch

> ♬ sonido original – .othergran1

## Gen Z Put This Song on Repeat to Manifest Good Luck and Cash

The trend has clearly found an audience. The New York Post reported that over 5,000 clips using the music were posted in recent weeks, while Billboard said streams of “Ring My Bell” jumped 277% over the past month, reaching 2.53 million official streams in a single week. Some users swear the song brought them gigs, cash, and ideal thrift finds. That sounds more like a run of good timing than anything mystical.

There are elements of this that are real, even if the magic-money angle is not. The Post quoted Dr. Patrick K. Porter, founder of BrainTap Technologies, saying, “Music activates multiple brain systems simultaneously—emotional centers, memory networks, attention pathways.” He also said repeated listening can strengthen neural pathways, especially when emotion and intention are involved. Audio expert Nikki Camilleri told the paper that a song can become “a shortcut to a target mental state.”

That explanation isn’t as fun as “disco song unlocks wealth portal,” but it’s also a lot easier to believe. A song can hype you up, pull you out of a bad headspace, and make you feel a little more on top of your game, a little luckier, a little readier to get out of your comfort zone. That explanation is believable. The rest feels like people on TikTok giving a catchy song way too much power.

# Description

Note : `This project uses the API from Tiktok & Unofficial Tiktok API from Another Website. This project is not affiliated with Tiktok. `

- This project is made to help users to download videos, images / slides and music from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to view someone's profile from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to view comments from a video on Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to search for users, live streams and videos on Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to get user's posts, reposts and liked videos from Tiktok.
- This project is made to help users to get videos, images / slides from a Tiktok collection or playlist.
- This project is also made to help users to get trending content and creators from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to get videos that use a specific music/audio track by music ID from Tiktok.
- This project is also made to help users to get detailed information about a music/audio track from Tiktok.

# Quick Installation

Install using our automated script:

```bash
curl -o install.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TobyG74/tiktok-api-dl/master/install.sh
chmod +x install.sh
./install.sh
```

The script automatically:

- Verifies Node.js installation and version
- Installs the library using npm or yarn
- Provides usage examples

# Installation Methods

## Using NPM

```bash
npm install @tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl
```

## Using Yarn

```bash
yarn add @tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl
```

## Using Github

```bash
npm install github:TobyG74/tiktok-api-dl
```

# Usage Guide

## Getting Tiktok Cookie

1. Install [Cookie-Editor](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cookie-editor/hlkenndednhfkekhgcdicdfddnkalmdm)
2. Login to [Tiktok](https://tiktok.com)
3. Open Cookie-Editor
4. Copy the cookie and use it in your code: `COOKIE: "YOUR_COOKIE"`

## Using CLI

### Global Installation

```bash
npm install -g @tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl
tiktokdl [command] [options]
```

### Direct Usage

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TobyG74/tiktok-api-dl.git
cd tiktok-api-dl
npm install
npx ts-node src/cli/index.ts [command] [options]
```

### NPM Script

```bash
npm run cli  [command] [options]
```

### CLI Usage

```bash
$ tiktokdl -h
Usage: tiktokdl [options] [command]

Tiktok downloader and search CLI tool

Options:
  -V, --version                output the version number
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  download [options] <url>     Download Tiktok Video / Slide / Music
  cookie                       Cookie Manager
  search                       Search Tiktok users or live streams
  getvideocomments [options] <url>  Get comments from a Tiktok video
  getuserposts [options] <username>  Get posts from a Tiktok user
  getuserreposts [options] <username>  Get reposts from a Tiktok user
  stalk [options] <username>   Stalk a Tiktok user
  help [command]               display help for command
```

### Example Cookie Usage

```bash
# Set Tiktok Cookie to use in commands
tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_COOKIE"

# Get Tiktok Cookie
tiktokdl cookie get

# Delete Tiktok Cookie
tiktokdl cookie delete
```

## Building from Source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TobyG74/tiktok-api-dl.git
cd tiktok-api-dl
npm install
npm run build
```

# Features

## Tiktok Downloader

```javascript
const Tiktok = require("@tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl")

const url = "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx"
Tiktok.Downloader(url, {
  version: "v1", // "v1" | "v2" | "v3"
  proxy: "YOUR_PROXY", // optional
  showOriginalResponse: true // optional, v1 only
}).then((result) => console.log(result))
```

### CLI Usage

```bash
# Download Tiktok Video
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx"

# Download Tiktok Video with version
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx" -v v1

# Download Tiktok Video with Custom Output Directory Path
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx" -v v1 -o "/path/to/save/video.mp4"

# Download Tiktok Video with Proxy
tiktokdl download "https://vt.tiktok.com/xxxxxxxx" -v v1 -proxy "http://your-proxy-url"

# Download Collection or Playlist
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/collection/name-id"
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/playlist/name-id"

# Download Collection or Playlist with Count
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/collection/name-id" -c 5
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/playlist/name-id" -c 5

# Download Collection or Playlist with Proxy
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/collection/name-id" -c 5 -proxy "http://your-proxy-url"
tiktokdl download "https://www.tiktok.com/@username/playlist/name-id" -c 5 -proxy "http://your-proxy-url"
```

## Tiktok Search

## Tiktok Get Music Detail

Get detailed information about a music/audio track by providing the music ID or URL. This feature uses xttparams encryption for enhanced security.

```javascript
const Tiktok = require("@tobyg74/tiktok-api-dl")

// Using music ID
const musicId = "7562597337407785760"
Tiktok.GetMusicDetail(musicId, {
  cookie: "YOUR_COOKIE", // required
  proxy: "YOUR_PROXY" // optional
}).then((result) => console.log(result))

// Or using music URL
const musicUrl = "https://www.tiktok.com/music/QKThr-6771810675950880769"
Tiktok.GetMusicDetail(musicUrl, {
  cookie: "YOUR_COOKIE"
}).then((result) => console.log(result))
```

### CLI Usage

**Note:** This command requires a cookie. Set your cookie first using `tiktokdl cookie set `

```bash
# Set cookie first (required)
tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_COOKIE_VALUE"

# Get music detail by ID
tiktokdl getmusicdetail 7562597337407785760

# Get music detail by URL
tiktokdl getmusicdetail "https://www.tiktok.com/music/QKThr-6771810675950880769"

# Get music detail with proxy
tiktokdl getmusicdetail 7562597337407785760 --proxy "http://your-proxy-url"

# Get raw JSON response
tiktokdl getmusicdetail 7562597337407785760 -r
```

Download music/audio files from TikTok. Requires cookie authentication.

### CLI Usage for Downloading Music

```bash
# Set cookie first (required for downloading)
tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_TIKTOK_COOKIE"

# Download by music ID
tiktokdl downloadmusic 7562597337407785760

# Download by music URL
tiktokdl downloadmusic "https://www.tiktok.com/music/QKThr-6771810675950880769"

# Custom output directory
tiktokdl downloadmusic 7562597337407785760 -o "./my-music"

# With proxy
tiktokdl downloadmusic 7562597337407785760 --proxy "http://your-proxy-url"
```

**How to get TikTok cookie:**

1. Open TikTok in your browser and login
2. Open DevTools (F12)
3. Go to Application/Storage > Cookies
4. Copy the entire cookie value
5. Set it using: `tiktokdl cookie set "YOUR_COOKIE"`

### Overall Ring Market Trends

The ring market is characterized by consistent demand across various categories, with notable fluctuations influenced by material preferences and seasonal trends. Gold rings consistently lead in search interest, followed by diamond and silver rings, indicating a strong preference for precious metals and gemstones. Amazon data further segments the market into distinct niches such as birthstone/gemstone rings, promise/wedding bands, and engagement/statement rings, each with unique growth drivers and customer preferences.

#### Market Scale & Growth

#### Growth Drivers

- Material Preference: Gold remains the dominant material in terms of search interest, suggesting a strong consumer preference for its perceived value and aesthetic appeal 1. Diamond rings also exhibit significant search volume, indicating sustained demand for high-value engagement and statement pieces 1.
- Seasonal Demand: Specific ring categories, such as women's promise and engagement rings, show significant seasonal spikes in search volume, particularly in June, suggesting peak periods for proposals and related gift-giving occasions 4.
- Customization and Uniqueness: The market for trendy women's birthstone and gemstone rings highlights a demand for unique, handcrafted, and vintage-style jewelry, indicating that consumers are looking for personalized and distinctive products 2.

#### Competitive Landscape

- Niche Specialization: The Amazon data reveals a fragmented market with distinct niches. Suppliers focusing on specific themes like "Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings" or "Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings" can cater to targeted consumer segments 23.
- Product Differentiation: Success in these niches often hinges on unique selling points, such as handmade Victorian styles, specific materials like 925 sterling silver, or addressing specific customer pain points like product size or odor 234.
- Quality and Design: For women's promise and engagement rings, elegant design, the ability to enhance ring sparkle, and good build quality are significant positive factors, while issues like large size or battery problems can negatively impact customer satisfaction 4.

### Google Trends Analysis

Google Trends data indicates a dynamic landscape for ring-related searches, with "gold ring" consistently holding the highest search interest. The data shows clear seasonal patterns and material preferences among global searchers.

Global search interest for different types of rings over time

Chart data sourced from 1.

The chart above illustrates the normalized search heat for "silver ring," "gold ring," and "diamond ring" from December 2024 to January 2026. "Gold ring" consistently maintains the highest search interest, peaking at 100 in January 2026. "Diamond ring" shows significant interest, with a peak of 84 in January 2026, while "silver ring" has the lowest search volume, peaking at 38 in January 2026. All three categories exhibit a general upward trend towards the end of the year and into the new year, suggesting seasonal demand.

#### Temporal Patterns

- Seasonal Peaks: Search interest for all three ring types, particularly "gold ring" and "diamond ring," shows a noticeable increase towards the end of the year (August to January), with the highest values observed in December 2025 and January 2026 1. This pattern suggests heightened consumer interest during holiday seasons and possibly engagement periods.
- Consistent Dominance of Gold: "Gold ring" consistently holds the highest search volume throughout the observed period, indicating its enduring popularity and status as a preferred material 1.

#### Peak & Trough Analysis

- Gold Ring Peaks: The search heat for "gold ring" reached its lowest point at 58 in May 2025 and peaked at 100 in January 2026 1. This significant fluctuation highlights strong seasonal demand.
- Diamond Ring Peaks: "Diamond ring" searches were lowest at 44 in March and May 2025, and highest at 84 in January 2026 1. This also suggests a strong end-of-year surge.
- Silver Ring Stability: "Silver ring" searches remained relatively stable at lower levels, with a trough of 20 in March and May 2025 and a peak of 38 in January 2026 1. While it also shows an upward trend towards the end of the year, its overall search volume is significantly lower than gold and diamond.

#### Strategic implications

- Inventory Management: Suppliers should anticipate increased demand for gold and diamond rings during the holiday season and early new year, adjusting inventory levels accordingly to capitalize on peak sales periods.
- Marketing Focus: Marketing campaigns should strategically target the end-of-year period, emphasizing gold and diamond rings for gifting and special occasions. For silver rings, a focus on affordability or unique designs might be more effective given their lower search volume.

### Amazon Trends Analysis

Amazon data highlights specific niche markets within the ring category, each with distinct characteristics in terms of search volume, sales, and customer feedback. These insights are crucial for optimizing product offerings and marketing strategies.

Average sales count for different ring themes on Amazon from July to December 2025

Chart data sourced from Accio.

The bar chart above displays the average sales count for three distinct ring themes on Amazon from July to December 2025. "Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings" consistently shows the highest average sales count, peaking at 987.55 in August 2025. "Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings" demonstrates a fluctuating but generally increasing sales trend, reaching its highest at 613.25 in September 2025. "Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings" maintains the lowest sales volume among the three, with a peak of 153.36 in August 2025.

Search volume for different ring themes on Amazon from July to November 2025

Chart data sourced from 234.

The bar chart above illustrates the search volume for three distinct ring themes on Amazon from July to November 2025. "Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings" generally exhibits the highest search volume, peaking at 136.3 in August 2025. "Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings" follows closely, with its highest search volume at 129.2 in August 2025. "Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings" consistently has the lowest search volume among the three, peaking at 89.0 in August 2025.

#### More detailed data

Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings

#### Temporal Patterns

- Birthstone & Gemstone Rings: This category shows strong potential with search volumes experiencing a positive trend, peaking with a 9.77% increase in April 2024 from the previous month 2. Sales also show a significant peak in September 2025 at 613.25 units 2.
- Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings: Retail sales volume remained stable in September 2025, while search volumes fluctuated, revealing a peak in June with an 11.16% increase 3. Sales were generally lower compared to other categories, with a peak of 153.36 in August 2025 3.
- Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings: This category has steady search volume with significant spikes, reaching +22.25% month-on-month in June, indicating strong seasonal interest 4. It consistently shows the highest average sales count, peaking at 987.55 in August 2025 4.

#### Peak & Trough Analysis

- Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings: Search volume peaked at 136.3 in August 2025 and sales peaked at 613.25 in September 2025 2. This suggests a strong demand period in late summer and early fall.
- Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings: Search volume peaked at 129.2 in August 2025, while sales peaked at 153.36 in August 2025 3. This category shows a more modest peak compared to others.
- Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings: Search volume peaked at 89.0 in August 2025, and sales peaked at 987.55 in August 2025 4. The high sales volume despite lower search volume compared to other categories suggests strong conversion rates or established demand.

#### Customer Sentiment

- Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings: The theme recommendation highlights strong potential and robust demand, suggesting positive customer reception for unique and customized products 2.
- Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings: While sales are stable, a significant negative comment tag is "Unpleasant odor" (100.0%), indicating a critical area for product improvement 3. "Compact size" (100.0%) is a positive aspect.
- Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings: Positive feedback includes "Elegant design" (36.9%), "Enhances ring sparkle" (32.8%), and "Excellent for gifting" (9.8%) 4. Negative comments focus on "Large size" (36.1%), "Battery issues" (13.9%), and "Blue LED tint" (13.9%), indicating areas for design and quality control improvements 4.

#### Strategic implications

- Product Development: For "Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings," addressing the "unpleasant odor" is a critical priority to improve customer satisfaction and sales 3. For "Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings," focusing on offering smaller size options, improving battery placement, and refining LED light quality can enhance product appeal 4.
- Marketing and Positioning: Highlight unique selling points such as handmade Victorian style and 925 sterling silver for birthstone rings 2. For promise and engagement rings, emphasize elegant design and gifting potential, especially for night-time proposals 4.
- Inventory and Sales Forecasting: Leverage the identified seasonal spikes and sales trends to optimize inventory and sales strategies, particularly for "Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings" which show high sales volume 4.

### Final Verdict and Outlook

The ring market presents a dynamic landscape with clear opportunities for B2B e-commerce suppliers who can adapt to evolving consumer preferences and address specific product shortcomings. Gold and diamond rings maintain strong global search interest, while niche categories on Amazon demonstrate significant sales potential when aligned with customer needs.

#### Cross-Channel Synthesis

- Consistent Material Preference: Both Google Trends and Amazon data implicitly support the strong demand for precious metals and gemstones. Google searches for "gold ring" and "diamond ring" are consistently high 1, while Amazon's top-selling "Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings" often feature such materials, and "Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings" highlight the appeal of specific stones 24.
- Seasonal Demand Alignment: The end-of-year surge in Google searches for all ring types 1 aligns with the strong sales performance of "Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings" in August and the overall positive trend for "Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings" towards the latter half of the year on Amazon 24. This indicates a synchronized seasonal buying pattern across platforms.
- Importance of Niche and Quality: While Google Trends provides a broad overview of material interest, Amazon data delves into specific product categories and customer feedback, underscoring the importance of niche specialization and addressing quality concerns for sustained success 234.

#### Priority Insights

- Gold and Diamond Dominance: Gold and diamond rings will continue to be high-demand products, especially during peak seasons. Suppliers should prioritize sourcing and marketing efforts for these categories 1.
- Niche Market Potential: Specialized categories like birthstone/gemstone rings and promise/engagement rings offer significant growth opportunities, provided products are tailored to specific customer preferences and pain points 24.
- Quality Control is Paramount: Addressing negative feedback, such as "unpleasant odor" for modern promise rings or "large size" and "battery issues" for engagement rings, is crucial for improving customer satisfaction and market share 34.

#### Future Outlook

- Continued Growth in Precious Metals: Over the next 6-12 months, demand for gold and diamond rings is expected to remain strong, particularly around holiday seasons and engagement periods. Suppliers should prepare for increased order volumes and potentially higher pricing for these materials.
- Rise of Personalized and Unique Designs: The trend towards personalized and unique jewelry, as seen with birthstone and gemstone rings, is likely to grow. B2B suppliers should explore partnerships with manufacturers offering customization options and handcrafted designs.
- Focus on User Experience and Quality: As the market matures, consumer expectations for product quality and user experience will intensify. Suppliers who proactively address common complaints and offer innovative solutions (e.g., smaller sizes, better battery integration) will gain a competitive edge.

Common mistakes

## “My ring listing isn't selling” — usually one of these

Rings are competitive and visual. These four mistakes quietly sink ring listings.

Mistake 1

Targeting the bare word “ring”

“Ring” is far too broad and competitive for a new shop. Buyers who convert search a style — “moss agate engagement ring,” “birthstone stacking ring.” Pick a style + metal + recipient and own that phrase.

Mistake 2

Weak or inconsistent photography

Rings sell on the photo more than almost any other category. Dim, cluttered, or inconsistent shots kill conversion even when the SEO is perfect. Use clean, well-lit, on-hand and macro images.

Mistake 3

Missing metal / stone / size attributes

Etsy matches on attributes, and ring buyers filter hard by metal, stone, and size. Leaving these blank drops you out of filtered search and erodes trust. Fill every relevant attribute.

Mistake 4

Vague material / sizing claims

Ambiguous “gold” (plated vs solid vs filled) or unclear sizing leads to returns and bad reviews. Be specific about karat, plating, stone type, and resizing — it protects both ranking and reputation.

### Overall Market Trends in Trendy Ring Stores

The engagement ring market for 2026 is characterized by a strong emphasis on personalization, individuality, and a blend of vintage charm with modern aesthetics 2 3 4 5 6 7. Buyers are moving away from mass-produced, uniform styles towards rings that reflect their unique stories and personal tastes. This shift is driving demand for distinctive designs, including bold choices, intimate details, and designs that empower wearers to express their identity 2 3.

#### Market Scale & Growth

- Personalization as a Driver: The market is experiencing growth fueled by a desire for unique, custom, and bespoke designs, allowing couples to create rings that genuinely reflect their love story 4 6. This trend suggests a willingness to invest in more specialized and potentially higher-value products.
- Sustainability and Ethics: The increasing popularity of lab-grown diamonds indicates a growing consumer preference for ethical luxury and sustainable sourcing, offering quality and peace of mind 4 6. This factor is likely to influence purchasing decisions and brand loyalty.

#### Growth Drivers

- Celebrity Influence: High-profile engagements, such as those of Taylor Swift and Miley Cyrus, are significantly impacting trends, particularly in popularizing antique cuts like Old Mine and chunky, bezel-set designs 3 4 5. This celebrity endorsement drives mainstream adoption of specific styles.
- Social Media Impact: Platforms like TikTok have amplified certain trends, such as the "90210 ring" (a massive oval solitaire), although there's also a growing pushback against this homogeneity in favor of more distinctive pieces 5. Social media acts as both a trend accelerator and a platform for counter-trends.

#### Competitive Landscape

- Focus on Craftsmanship: Jewelers are emphasizing labor-intensive, crafted settings over polished uniformity, indicating a competitive edge for brands that can offer unique artistry and quality 5 7. This highlights a move towards artisanal and bespoke offerings.
- Diverse Offerings: The market is seeing a wide array of styles, from minimalist solitaires to elaborate cluster settings and colorful gemstones, catering to diverse preferences and budgets 2 6 7. This broadens the competitive landscape, requiring stores to offer comprehensive selections.

### Google Trends Analysis

Google Trends data for ring-related queries from January 2025 to January 2026 shows "ring sets" consistently dominating search interest, followed by "stackable rings" and "minimalist rings" 1. While "ring sets" maintain the highest search volume, "stackable rings" and "minimalist rings" show steady, albeit lower, interest, indicating a consistent demand for these styles.

Global search interest for 'ring sets', 'stackable rings', and 'minimalist rings' from January 2025 to January 2026

#### Temporal Patterns

- Dominance of Ring Sets: "Ring sets" consistently hold the highest search interest throughout the year, peaking in December 2025 with a normalized value of 94, suggesting a strong seasonal demand, possibly linked to holiday gifting or engagement season 1.
- Steady Interest in Other Styles: "Stackable rings" and "minimalist rings" maintain a relatively stable search volume, indicating a continuous, underlying demand for these versatile and understated styles, with a slight increase for "stackable rings" in November 2025 1.

#### Peak & Trough Analysis

- Peak for Ring Sets: The peak for "ring sets" in December 2025 (94) highlights a significant surge in interest towards the end of the year, likely driven by holiday shopping and proposals 1. Businesses should prepare for increased demand during this period.
- Minimalist Rings Fluctuation: "Minimalist rings" saw a notable spike in August 2025 (12) and December 2025 (11), which could be attributed to specific fashion trends or influencer promotions during those months 1.

#### Strategic Implications

- Targeted Marketing for Ring Sets: Given the high and seasonal search volume for "ring sets," businesses should implement targeted marketing campaigns leading up to and during the holiday season, emphasizing value and variety in their ring set offerings.
- Consistent Promotion of Stackable and Minimalist Rings: For "stackable rings" and "minimalist rings," a continuous marketing strategy focusing on their versatility, everyday wearability, and timeless appeal would be effective in capturing consistent consumer interest.
- Leverage Seasonal Spikes: Analyze the factors behind the August and December spikes for "minimalist rings" to identify potential opportunities for product launches or promotional activities that align with emerging micro-trends or seasonal events.

### Web-based Trends Analysis

The broader web trends for 2026 engagement rings highlight a significant shift towards personalized, unique, and meaningful designs, moving away from traditional uniformity 2 3 4 5 6 7. This includes a strong inclination towards vintage-inspired aesthetics, bold statements, and a focus on craftsmanship and ethical sourcing.

#### Big, Bold Diamonds and Colorful Gemstones

- Statement Stones: Large carat diamonds, particularly in timeless shapes like emerald, oval, marquise, and cushion cuts, are making a strong comeback, emphasizing presence and luxury 2 4. This trend is about creating a focal point with substantial, unforgettable pieces.
- Vibrant Hues: Colorful gemstones, especially teal, pastel, and red sapphires, are gaining popularity as expressive center stones 2 7. These offer personality and symbolism, appealing to those seeking non-traditional options that feel uniquely theirs.
- Warm Tones: Champagne diamonds are also trending, offering a natural softness and "quiet luxury" feel that white diamonds cannot replicate, often paired with warm metals like yellow and rose gold 2 5.

#### Vintage and Heirloom Romance

- Victorian & Art-Deco Settings: There's a renewed appreciation for vintage-inspired designs, with intricate metalwork, milgrain textures, filigree details, and sculptural halos reminiscent of Victorian and Art Deco eras 2 3 5 7. These designs blend historical sentiment with modern craftsmanship.
- Antique Cut Diamonds: Old Mine, Old European, and elongated antique cushion cuts are highly sought after for their unique character, warmth, and candlelit sparkle 4 5 7. These cuts are seen as a direct rejection of social-media homogeneity and overly perfect aesthetics.

#### Modern and Sculptural Forms

- Chunky, Sculptural Settings: Slim bands are being replaced by thicker, bolder, and more sculptural settings, particularly complementing cushion-cut diamonds 2 3 4 5 7. These designs offer an architectural and strong feel, with wide polished bands, substantial bezels, and modern signet-inspired silhouettes.
- Bezel Settings: Bezel settings, which fully encircle the stone, are gaining popularity for their sleek, contemporary look and excellent protection for gemstones 3 4 5 7. They offer clean lines and architectural precision, appealing to those with active lifestyles and minimalist preferences.
- East-West Settings: Diamonds placed horizontally along the band offer a modern twist on classic solitaires, especially for elongated shapes like emerald, marquise, and oval 4 5. This orientation provides a distinctive and refined alternative.

#### Personalization and Symbolism

- Custom and Bespoke Designs: Customization is at the forefront, with couples seeking rings that feel truly personal, from custom diamond shapes to unique settings and meaningful engravings 4 6. This allows for sustainable and intentionally designed pieces reflecting individual love stories.
- Three-Stone Settings: Representing past, present, and future, three-stone rings are being embraced with new creativity, mixing diamond shapes, band styles, and accents for deeply personal designs 4 6 7.
- Hidden Details: Secret design elements like hidden halos, surprise accents, and personalized engravings add depth and thoughtfulness to a ring's story 4 6.

#### Strategic Implications

- Curate Diverse Collections: To cater to the varied preferences, stores should curate collections that blend vintage-inspired pieces with modern, sculptural designs, offering a wide range of diamond cuts, gemstone colors, and setting styles.
- Emphasize Customization Services: Investing in and promoting bespoke design services will attract buyers looking for unique and personalized rings, aligning with the strong trend of individuality. Highlighting the ability to create custom pieces will be a key differentiator.
- Showcase Ethical Sourcing: Given the growing interest in ethical luxury, transparently communicating the sourcing and sustainability of materials, especially lab-grown diamonds, can enhance brand appeal and build trust with conscious consumers.
- Highlight Celebrity and Influencer Trends: Actively referencing and showcasing designs inspired by celebrity engagements can attract customers who are influenced by popular culture, while also offering alternatives that cater to a desire for unique pieces.

### Strategic Conclusions

The 2026 market for trendy rings, particularly engagement rings, is undergoing a significant transformation driven by a profound desire for personalization, individuality, and meaningful design. The overarching theme is a departure from conventional, mass-produced styles towards pieces that resonate deeply with personal stories and aesthetic preferences.

#### Cross-Channel Synthesis

- Consistent Demand for Uniqueness: Both Google Trends and web-based analyses underscore a strong and growing demand for unique ring styles. While Google Trends highlights the popularity of "ring sets," "stackable rings," and "minimalist rings" for broader appeal, web trends delve into the specifics of what makes an engagement ring "trendy"—namely, vintage-inspired designs, bold settings, and colorful gemstones 1 2 3 4 5 6 7. This indicates that while consumers are searching for general categories, their ultimate purchasing decisions are guided by a desire for distinctiveness.
- Influence of Celebrity and Social Media: The impact of celebrity endorsements and social media on trend adoption is evident across both data sets. Specific styles popularized by figures like Taylor Swift and Miley Cyrus quickly gain traction, influencing search queries and driving demand for particular cuts and settings 3 4 5. This highlights the importance of staying attuned to cultural shifts and leveraging influencer marketing.

#### Priority Insights

- Personalization is Paramount: The most critical insight is that personalization is no longer a niche but a central expectation. Buyers want rings that reflect their identity, whether through custom designs, unique gemstone choices, or vintage-inspired details 2 4 6. Businesses must prioritize offering extensive customization options and showcasing the unique stories behind their pieces.
- Vintage Aesthetics with Modern Craftsmanship: There's a clear preference for designs that evoke a sense of history and romance, such as Victorian and Art Deco styles, combined with modern execution and durability 2 3 5 7. This means offering pieces with intricate details, antique cuts, and robust settings like bezels.
- Boldness and Substance: The trend towards chunky, sculptural settings and larger, more prominent diamonds signifies a shift towards making a statement 2 3 4 5 7. This contrasts with the delicate styles of previous years, suggesting a market for more substantial and visually impactful rings.

#### Future Outlook

- Continued Diversification of Styles: The market will likely continue to diversify, with an even broader array of styles catering to individual tastes. Expect to see further innovation in mixed materials, unconventional gemstone pairings, and highly personalized engravings.
- Increased Emphasis on Ethical Sourcing and Transparency: As consumers become more conscious, the demand for ethically sourced materials, particularly lab-grown diamonds, will grow. Brands that can transparently communicate their sustainability practices will gain a competitive advantage.
- Hybrid Designs: Future trends may see more hybrid designs that seamlessly blend multiple popular elements, such as colorful antique-cut diamonds in chunky, sculptural bezel settings, offering even more unique combinations for discerning buyers.

## “My ring listing isn't selling” — usually one of these

Rings are competitive and visual. These four mistakes quietly sink ring listings.

Mistake 1

Targeting the bare word “ring”

“Ring” is far too broad and competitive for a new shop. Buyers who convert search a style — “moss agate engagement ring,” “birthstone stacking ring.” Pick a style + metal + recipient and own that phrase.

Mistake 2

Weak or inconsistent photography

Rings sell on the photo more than almost any other category. Dim, cluttered, or inconsistent shots kill conversion even when the SEO is perfect. Use clean, well-lit, on-hand and macro images.

Mistake 3

Missing metal / stone / size attributes

Etsy matches on attributes, and ring buyers filter hard by metal, stone, and size. Leaving these blank drops you out of filtered search and erodes trust. Fill every relevant attribute.

Mistake 4

Vague material / sizing claims

Ambiguous “gold” (plated vs solid vs filled) or unclear sizing leads to returns and bad reviews. Be specific about karat, plating, stone type, and resizing — it protects both ranking and reputation.

### Overall Ring Market Trends

The ring market is characterized by consistent demand across various categories, with notable fluctuations influenced by material preferences and seasonal trends. Gold rings consistently lead in search interest, followed by diamond and silver rings, indicating a strong preference for precious metals and gemstones. Amazon data further segments the market into distinct niches such as birthstone/gemstone rings, promise/wedding bands, and engagement/statement rings, each with unique growth drivers and customer preferences.

#### Market Scale & Growth

#### Growth Drivers

- Material Preference: Gold remains the dominant material in terms of search interest, suggesting a strong consumer preference for its perceived value and aesthetic appeal 1. Diamond rings also exhibit significant search volume, indicating sustained demand for high-value engagement and statement pieces 1.
- Seasonal Demand: Specific ring categories, such as women's promise and engagement rings, show significant seasonal spikes in search volume, particularly in June, suggesting peak periods for proposals and related gift-giving occasions 4.
- Customization and Uniqueness: The market for trendy women's birthstone and gemstone rings highlights a demand for unique, handcrafted, and vintage-style jewelry, indicating that consumers are looking for personalized and distinctive products 2.

#### Competitive Landscape

- Niche Specialization: The Amazon data reveals a fragmented market with distinct niches. Suppliers focusing on specific themes like "Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings" or "Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings" can cater to targeted consumer segments 23.
- Product Differentiation: Success in these niches often hinges on unique selling points, such as handmade Victorian styles, specific materials like 925 sterling silver, or addressing specific customer pain points like product size or odor 234.
- Quality and Design: For women's promise and engagement rings, elegant design, the ability to enhance ring sparkle, and good build quality are significant positive factors, while issues like large size or battery problems can negatively impact customer satisfaction 4.

### Google Trends Analysis

Google Trends data indicates a dynamic landscape for ring-related searches, with "gold ring" consistently holding the highest search interest. The data shows clear seasonal patterns and material preferences among global searchers.

Global search interest for different types of rings over time

Chart data sourced from 1.

The chart above illustrates the normalized search heat for "silver ring," "gold ring," and "diamond ring" from December 2024 to January 2026. "Gold ring" consistently maintains the highest search interest, peaking at 100 in January 2026. "Diamond ring" shows significant interest, with a peak of 84 in January 2026, while "silver ring" has the lowest search volume, peaking at 38 in January 2026. All three categories exhibit a general upward trend towards the end of the year and into the new year, suggesting seasonal demand.

#### Temporal Patterns

- Seasonal Peaks: Search interest for all three ring types, particularly "gold ring" and "diamond ring," shows a noticeable increase towards the end of the year (August to January), with the highest values observed in December 2025 and January 2026 1. This pattern suggests heightened consumer interest during holiday seasons and possibly engagement periods.
- Consistent Dominance of Gold: "Gold ring" consistently holds the highest search volume throughout the observed period, indicating its enduring popularity and status as a preferred material 1.

#### Peak & Trough Analysis

- Gold Ring Peaks: The search heat for "gold ring" reached its lowest point at 58 in May 2025 and peaked at 100 in January 2026 1. This significant fluctuation highlights strong seasonal demand.
- Diamond Ring Peaks: "Diamond ring" searches were lowest at 44 in March and May 2025, and highest at 84 in January 2026 1. This also suggests a strong end-of-year surge.
- Silver Ring Stability: "Silver ring" searches remained relatively stable at lower levels, with a trough of 20 in March and May 2025 and a peak of 38 in January 2026 1. While it also shows an upward trend towards the end of the year, its overall search volume is significantly lower than gold and diamond.

#### Strategic implications

- Inventory Management: Suppliers should anticipate increased demand for gold and diamond rings during the holiday season and early new year, adjusting inventory levels accordingly to capitalize on peak sales periods.
- Marketing Focus: Marketing campaigns should strategically target the end-of-year period, emphasizing gold and diamond rings for gifting and special occasions. For silver rings, a focus on affordability or unique designs might be more effective given their lower search volume.

### Amazon Trends Analysis

Amazon data highlights specific niche markets within the ring category, each with distinct characteristics in terms of search volume, sales, and customer feedback. These insights are crucial for optimizing product offerings and marketing strategies.

Average sales count for different ring themes on Amazon from July to December 2025

Chart data sourced from Accio.

The bar chart above displays the average sales count for three distinct ring themes on Amazon from July to December 2025. "Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings" consistently shows the highest average sales count, peaking at 987.55 in August 2025. "Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings" demonstrates a fluctuating but generally increasing sales trend, reaching its highest at 613.25 in September 2025. "Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings" maintains the lowest sales volume among the three, with a peak of 153.36 in August 2025.

Search volume for different ring themes on Amazon from July to November 2025

Chart data sourced from 234.

The bar chart above illustrates the search volume for three distinct ring themes on Amazon from July to November 2025. "Trendy Women's Birthstone & Gemstone Rings" generally exhibits the highest search volume, peaking at 136.3 in August 2025. "Modern Promise & Wedding Band Rings" follows closely, with its highest search volume at 129.2 in August 2025. "Women's Promise & Engagement Statement Rings" consistently has the lowest search volume among the three, peaking at 89.0 in August 2025.
